races.display_title: Cork Maiden
races.verdict: A huge field but only a handful make any serious appeal. Preference is for OTSANA , who shaped with considerable promise when fifth at the Curragh on debut last month and now drops to 6f. She can get the better of Saint Agatha , who is yet to progress from her debut, but a first-time tongue tie could be just what's required. Noble Irish and Inform are newcomers representing powerful connections so they complete the shortlist. OTSANA (IRE) SAINT AGATHA (IRE) NOBLE IRISH (IRE)

races.display_title: William Hill Silver Cup Handicap
races.verdict: GALYX is worth another chance to confirm the promise of his Sandown run with conditions in his favour this time. Unexposed 3-y-o Bay of Myths is bred to be much better than an opening mark of 79 so he is potentially a massive threat, while the strong-travelling Impartiality is surely going to come good soon. GALYX (IRE) BAY OF MYTHS (IRE) IMPARTIALITY

races.display_title: Ward Homes Yorkshire Handicap
races.verdict: ON THE RIVER returned to form when third at Newcastle last time, despite coming from further back than ideal, and he can build on that effort to take advantage of what is a workable mark. Next best could be Hot Cash , who looks interesting back on softer ground, while The Sweet Escape would enter calculations if taking up this engagement. ON THE RIVER HOT CASH THE SWEET ESCAPE
